visual_identity.body: Plump, shrew-like body covered in thick, soft-looking brown and cream fur. A long, slightly furry tail.
visual_identity.face: Twitching pink nose; long, delicate whiskers; and very large, round 'night-vision' eyes to show it likes the dark.
visual_identity.paws: Tiny, dexterous five-fingered paws, perfect for holding small seeds or insects.

personality: Nervous, busy, and very fast. It sniffs the air constantly and scurries with high-energy movements.
